caption: The drawing depicts a weather vane in the shape of a rooster. The rooster is colored in shades of brown with darker brown and black details accentuating its feathers, and it has a red comb and wattle. The rooster stands atop a horizontal structure with a stylized, ornate script that spells out the word "WEATHER," with the "E" separated slightly from the rest and in a less ornate, more block-like font. The overall color of the structure beneath the rooster is a medium brown. The background of the drawing is a light beige color. At the bottom right of the drawing, the name "FLORIAN ROKITA" is written in small, dark capital letters.
title: Weathercock
